title: Tracing the Drift: Attributing Alignment Failures to Training-Time Belief Sources in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'alignment drift,' which it defines as Large Language Models producing outputs that violate safety, ethical, or human value expectations. It explicitly evaluates the model's 'moral' and 'normative' belief sources and introduces the Alignment Drift Benchmark (ADB) to test ethically sensitive domains such as hate speech and self-harm.
